More than a vocal group

A show that sounds huge—and feels personal.

SIX turns six microphones into drums, guitars, bass, horns and soaring harmony, then surrounds that sound with comedy, storytelling and the unmistakable chemistry of real brothers.

The music moves through rock, pop, country, classics and modern hits. The laughter comes from a lifetime together. The emotional moments arrive naturally—often when the audience least expects them.

The current SIX

Six distinct personalities. One family sound.

The original assigned-color tradition is used here as a subtle visual thread—not as a costume mandate or a return to an older marketing era.

Seven brothers have contributed to the larger story.
Across decades and changing configurations, seven Knudsen brothers helped create the family sound that ultimately became SIX. The public presentation remains focused on the six brothers performing today.
Dysfunctional sibling comedy

The harmonies are tight. The family boundaries are negotiable.

“Dysfunctional” works best as a playful flavor—not as the entire identity. The stronger promise is authenticity: the audience is watching six brothers who genuinely know how to push one another’s buttons.

Brother comedy you couldn’t write if you tried.

The timing, irritation, affection and history are real. That is what makes it funny instead of manufactured.

Working public phrase

Music, heart and dysfunctional sibling comedy.

This keeps the familiar term while making it clear that the dysfunction is affectionate entertainment—not the whole definition of SIX.

Built for the theater.

Five screens, theatrical lighting, vocal precision and six distinct personalities create a full Branson-scale experience.
